Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(a):
    a=[list(map(int,r)) for r in a]; H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in a for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]; sep=c.most_common(2)[1][0]
    rest=[v for v in c if v not in (bg,sep)]
    # cage lines: full sep rows and full sep cols
    sep_rows={r for r in range(H) if all(a[r][cc]==sep for cc in range(W))}
    sep_cols={cc for cc in range(W) if all(a[r][cc]==sep for r in range(H))}
    # markers off cage: cells with value in rest
    markers={v:[(r,cc) for (r,cc) in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if a[rr][cc]==v] if (rr,cc) not in [(rr,cc) for rr in sep_rows for cc in range(W) and False ]]}
    markers={v:[(r,cc) for (r,cc) in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if a[rr][cc]==v] if not (any(rr==rr2 and rr2 in sep_rows for rr2 in range(H)) or any(cc==cc2 and cc2 in sep_cols for cc2 in range(W)))]: ...}
    markers={v:[(r,cc) for (r,cc) in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if a[rr][cc]==v] if not (r in sep_rows or cc in sep_cols)] for v in rest}

import numpy as np, collections
def const_lines(a, bg=None):
    H,W=a.shape
    vals=collections.Counter(int(x) for x in a.flatten())
    bg=int(max(vals,key=lambda k:vals[k]))
    cr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(int(a[r][c]) for c in range(W)))==1 and int(a[r][0])!=bg]
    cc=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(int(a[r][c]) for r in range(H)))==1 and int(a[0][c])!=bg]
    return cr,cc,bg
for k in ['Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 3 input','Demo pair 4 input','Demo pair 5 input']:
    a=np.array(G[k]); cr,cc,bg=const_lines(a)
    print(k,'bg',bg,'rowdiv',cr,'coldiv',cc)

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows) and k not in G:
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in [2,3]:
    k=f'Demo pair {n} input'; o=k.replace('input','output')
    g=G[k]; e=G[o]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r); print(n,'shape',len(g),len(g[0]),sorted(cnt.items()))
    print('exp',cnt[collections.Counter(v for r in e for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]],'vs got',json.dumps(e))
    # show exp shape
    print('exp shape',(len(e),len(e[0])))

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows) and k not in G:
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in [2,6]:
    k=f'Demo pair {n} input'; o=k.replace('input','output')
    g=G[k]; e=G[o]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[i for i in range(len(g)) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    vc=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(len(g))) and g[0][j]!=bg]
    print('pair',n,'lines:',hr,vc)
    lset={(r,c) for r in hr for c in range(len(g[0]))} | {(r,c) for c in vc for r in range(len(g))}
    mkrs=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in lset]
    print('markers:',mkrs)

import collections,json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    dr=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and all(v!=bg for v in g[i])]
    dc=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(r[j] for r in g))==1 and all(r[j]!=bg for r in g)]
    lc=collections.Counter([g[i][0] for i in dr]+[r[dc[0]] for r in [g]] if dc else []).most_common(1)[0][0] if (dr or dc) else None
    out=[]
    for bi in range(len(dr)+1):
        r0=(dr[bi-1] if bi else -1)+1; r1=(dr[bi] if bi+1<=len(dr) else H)

        for bj in range(len(dc)+1):

            vals=set(g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            cand={v for v in vals if v not in (bg,lc)}
            row.append(next(iter(cand)) if len(cand)==1 else bg)

import collections,json
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines=[]
    for i in range(h):
        v=g[i][0]
        if all(g[i][j]==v for j in range(w)) and v!=bg: lines.append(('R',int(i),int(v)))
    for j in range(w):
        v=g[0][j]
        if all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(h)) and v!=bg: lines.append(('C',int(j),int(v)))
    rs=sorted([l[1] for l in lines if l[0]=='R']); cs=sorted([l[1] for l in lines if l[0]=='C'])
    lb=[(rs[i],rs[i+1]) for i in range(len(rs)-1)]
    cb=[(cs[j],cs[j+1]) for j in range(len(cs)-1)]
    lc=collections.Counter(v for _,_,v in lines).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for (a,b) in lb:
        oc=[]
        for (c,d) in cb:
            s=set(g[r][cc] for r in range(a+1,b) for cc in range(c+1,d))
            others=sorted(s-{bg,lc})
            oc.append(others[0] if len(others)==1 else bg)
        out.append(oc)
    return out
for n in range(2,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; eo=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    o=solve(gi)
    print(n,o==eo,'got',json.dumps(o),'exp',json.dumps(eo))

from collections import Counter
def f(g, linecond=None):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    R=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and (linecond is None or g[i][0]!=bg)]
    C=[j for j in range(w) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and (linecond is None or g[0][j]!=bg)]
    # use edges as boundaries too? Try excluding edge-bands and falling back to bg
    res=[[bg]*len(C) for _ in range(len(R))]
    for ai,(ra,rbi) in enumerate(zip([0]+R,R+[h])):
        for bi,(ca,cbe) in enumerate(zip([0]+C,C+[w])):
            v=None
            for i in range(ra+1,rb):
                for j in range(ca+1,cbe):
                    if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=g[ra][ca]:
                        v=g[i][j]
            res[ai][bi]=v if v is not None else bg
    return res

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # full-constant lines whose color != dominant background, AND also include constant colors that appear exactly once...
    # Try: any row/col that is all one color, regardless of bg; but exclude rows/cols that are all bg
    R=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    C=[j for j in range(w) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    rb=[0]+R+[h]; cb=[0]+C+[w]
    return [[bg]*(len(cb)-2) for _ in range(len(rb)-2)],R,C,bg

for n in range(2,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; ro=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    R,C,bg,_=f(gi)
    print(n,'match',R=='demo_R'[n] if False else True,'want',(len(ro),len(ro[0])),
          'got',(len(R)+1,len(C)+1),'lines',R,C,bg)
